sentences.text: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate

**Scheme Brief Description:** “Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate" is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal aims to provide supply of subsidized yarn to the PWCS, Khadi Weavers' Societies etc.

**Who is this for:** Individual, Registered Societies, Joint Liability Groups (JLGS), Self Help Groups (SHGS), Trust; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship
**Where it applies:** West Bengal; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** “Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate&quot; is a sub-scheme under &quot;West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, launched by the Micro, Small &amp; Medium Enterprise and Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal on 7th March, 2024, and it shall remain in force for a period of five years. The objective of this sub-scheme is to provide supply of subsidized yarn to the Primary Weavers&#39; Cooperative Societies and Khadi Weavers&#39; Societies etc. and Individual weavers. <br>

**Benefits / Assistance:** - TANTUJA will supply yarn to handloom societies at a 10% discounted rate. - TANTUJA will receive a 5% administrative cost from the State Government for transportation, storage, and handling. - The Khadi Society, registered under various acts, will receive a 10% discount on roving or high count cotton fibre purchased from WBKVIB. - The WBKVIB will be reimbursed by the State government for the total concession amount given to the Khadi Societies, along with a 5% administrative cost for transportation, storing, and handling charges. > **Note**: This does not apply to yarn procured under the NHDP Scheme.

**Application Process:** - An eligible PWCs/ Khadi society/ Individual Weaver will apply either in online or in offline mode in the prescribed format (as would be notified by this [department](https://wbmsme.gov.in/)) before the Director, Textiles. > **Helpdesk**: [Office Addresses and Contact Details (District Wise)](https://www.westbengalhandloom.org/off_addrs).
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles Department
**Tags:** Handloom, Khadi Weavers, PWCS, Khadi Societies, Yarn, Subsidized Rate
